## What lives here
Build prerequisites: credentials, settings and information a build needs. They are worked out before anything is built, settled from the vault or by asking the user, and handed to the code specifications.

## Conventions
Values never travel in answers, only vault references. Analysis failures never block a build.

## Entry points
`layer.BuildPrerequisitesLayer` (in the pipelines) and `code_check` (codegen R4b).
